display.title: Episode 451: The Silver Mirror
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi shows how to turn your whole house into a mitzvah with a tzedakah pushka, two brothers say the Shema, and a Rebbe teaches a rich man the lesson of the silver mirror.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens with 'great news': the word mitzvah also means connection, and by fixing your tzedakah pushka permanently to a wall of your home, the whole house becomes part of the great mitzvah of tzedakah, which brings Moshiach closer. Children are invited to write in about it, and the first letters received win gift certificates for the Tzivos Hashem gift shop. After the Hakochainik march, two brothers recite the Shema in Studio 604 and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time tells of Reb Avraham, a kind and generous man who asks a visiting Rebbe for a blessing of wealth so he can give more tzedakah. The Rebbe warns him that riches can change a person. As his business grows, Reb Avraham stops davening in shul, neglects his learning and turns poor people away. A year later the Rebbe returns and shows him the difference between a window and a mirror: once glass is coated with silver, you see only yourself. Reb Avraham does teshuvah and becomes generous again.
display.lesson: Wealth is a blessing only when it is shared; do not let the 'silver' keep you from seeing others in need.
